summary: Frontend-only verification of the delete bug fix (window.confirm replaced by in-app shadcn AlertDialog). Executed end-to-end delete flows for Product, Category, and Customer via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All three deletes now open an in-app confirmation dialog (data-testid='delete-confirm-dialog'), Cancel keeps the record, Delete removes it, and deletion persists across page reload. No native browser confirm() dialog fired during any of the flows.

design_issues.screen: All shadcn Dialogs (Add Product, Add Customer, Add Category)
issues: React console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Non-blocking a11y improvement — add DialogDescription to each DialogContent.

action_items: OPTIONAL a11y polish: add a <DialogDescription> to Add Product / Add Category / Add Customer dialogs to silence the Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: StockPage.jsx / CustomersPage.jsx: delete flow now correctly uses AlertDialog with deleteTarget state. State is properly reset via onOpenChange and after confirmDelete — no leaks.
AlertDialog and Dialog have correct data-testids for testing (delete-confirm-dialog, delete-cancel-btn, delete-confirm-btn, delete-product-<id>, delete-category-<id>, delete-customer-<id>).

No native window.confirm() calls remain in handleDeleteProduct / handleDeleteCategory / handleDeleteCustomer — confirmed by grep-equivalent inspection and by page.on('dialog') listener never firing during E2E.
seed_data_creation: Temporary records created and then deleted during the run: product 'TEST_ToDelete', category 'TEST_Category', customer 'TEST_CustomerToDelete'. Seed data 'Test Urea' and 'DAP' were left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Delete confirmation is now driven by shadcn AlertDialog on StockPage and CustomersPage. Use data-testid='delete-confirm-btn' to confirm and 'delete-cancel-btn' to cancel. All three DELETE endpoints return 200 and lists refresh via fetchData()/fetchCustomers(). No native confirm() is used anywhere in these pages.
verified_scenarios: Login with admin/swarna123 succeeds and redirects to dashboard.
Stock page: Add Product creates a new row (TEST_ToDelete).
Stock page: trash icon on product row opens delete-confirm-dialog; Cancel keeps the row; Delete removes it; after page reload the row is still absent.
Stock page: Add Category creates a new category chip; trash on that chip opens the same confirmation dialog; Cancel keeps it; Delete removes it.
Customers page: Add Customer creates a row (TEST_CustomerToDelete); trash icon opens confirmation dialog; Cancel keeps it; Delete removes it; after reload it is still gone.
page.on('dialog') listener attached — no native browser confirm() dialogs were emitted during the entire test session.
